name: Invitation response record
description: Represent an explicitly supplied invitation and reply as component-level stance, permission and proposed next-step data.

inputs.invitation: Exact text and separately named requested components.
inputs.reply: Exact supplied text; absent reply is allowed and remains unknown.
inputs.actor_scope: Constructed or actual, known speaker and relevant role.
inputs.context: Only explicit timing, access and prior permission supplied with the case.
inputs.identity: record_set_id scopes one participant and invitation; event_id is unique within that set; participant_id, invitation_id and component_id identify whose answer to which request is represented. Replaying the same event_id is idempotent only when its canonical content is identical; conflicting reuse is unresolved.
inputs.order: Supplied effective order and received order; uncertain effective order stays uncertain. Do not infer chronology from file position alone.
inputs.prior_response: Exact base_state_id, correction_of event IDs and per-component revision IDs, or null for a first reply.
inputs.evidence_role: Participant statement, organizer proposal, third-party report, supplied observation, or authored construction; quoted speaker is distinct from reporting speaker.

outputs.response_record: A stable state_id and, for each requested component, stable attribute revision IDs, evidence span, accepted/declined/conditional/unknown stance, stated condition, next-step proposal and confirmation dimensions.
outputs.unknowns: Missing meanings that would change stance or next step.
outputs.revision_record: Append-only event with event_id, base_state_id, correction_of IDs and exact evidence; active component attributes retain their source event and revision ID; superseded values and no-op reaffirmations remain recoverable.
outputs.confirmation_dimensions: interpretation_confirmed, option_agreed, performance_observed are separately evidenced, not inferred from one another.
outputs.change_set: Affected component attributes, unchanged attributes, and unresolved ordering or referent conflicts.

success_criteria: Every component has a stance or explicit unknown.
Accepted scope does not exceed the evidence span.
A proposed change remains a proposal until a reply accepts it.
Human-action observations require supplied provenance; unsupported human effects, inferred feelings and causal changes are not claimed.
steps: Validate record_set_id, event_id, participant_id and invitation_id before reduction. Reject a mixed participant/invitation bundle. Treat an exact duplicate event as a replay; return unresolved identity_conflict when the same event_id has different canonical content.
Bind the invitation, participant, component identifiers, exact reply, evidence role, supplied effective order, base state, correction targets and prior component revisions.
Associate each explicit reply clause with its requested component.

Apply a participant correction only to the explicitly affected attributes. Carry unchanged attributes from the exact base state and preserve superseded values. Record a repeated equal value as a reaffirmation rather than a new semantic change. An absent later mention is not a withdrawal.

Treat organizer proposals and third-party quotations as separate evidence. They do not establish a participant commitment in this local procedure. An earlier effective message received later does not replace a later effective correction.
Record accepted, declined, conditional or unknown stance for each component; retain stated conditions.
Separate the speaker's stated reason from a hypothesis about motive.
Create a next-step proposal only for an unresolved component that matters to the invitation.
Record confirmation of interpretation, agreement to a proposed option, and observed performance separately. A stated future commitment supplies no performance observation.
Assign the derived state_id and component revision IDs, then return the evidence-bearing response record and unresolved meanings.
verification: Trace each non-unknown stance to the supplied text.
Compare the scope of every accepted component with its evidence.
Check that proposed action is not recorded as recipient agreement.
Resolve every inherited attribute and component revision ID to an existing earlier event in the same record set.
Check uniqueness of state, event and component revision IDs and reject conflicting event-ID reuse.
Check whether the correction changes a fact, the participant stance, or only an organizer proposal.
If chronology or authority is unresolved, return that unresolved state.
complexity: moderate: semantic clause-to-component mapping requires judgment.
dependencies: Existing explicit goal and invitation components; original AL offers paraphrase preparation but cannot supply an absent reply.
reuse_potential: Local analysis of exploratory invitations, workshop roles and bounded help requests.
when_to_use: A concrete invitation has separable requests and a supplied reply or explicit absence of reply.
Preparing a bounded collaboration draft without claiming live confirmation.

examples.input: Invitation: read and host. Reply: I will read two pages; I cannot host.
examples.output: Reading accepted for two pages; hosting declined; no motive inferred.

examples.input: Invitation: join once. Reply: Only if it is audio.
examples.output: Joining conditional on audio; a proposed audio arrangement remains unconfirmed.
Attendance stance unknown; no assent or disinterest inferred.

examples.input: Invitation: read. Reply: I like the idea but cannot take this on.
examples.output: Positive stated interest; task declined; the predicates coexist.

failure_modes.consequence: A bounded acceptance spreads to another request.
An absent reply becomes invented disinterest.
An explicit timing constraint becomes reluctance.
failure_modes.prevention: Retain evidence and mark extra interpretations hypothetical.

failure_modes.consequence: A conditional offer becomes a commitment.
failure_modes.prevention: Carry the condition into every derived output.

gosm_integration.after: Invitation components and available reply are supplied.
gosm_integration.artifact_scope: Local authored procedure, not an original skill.

revision_origin.reason: ITERATE findings T01–T12; not a modification to an archived Reasoningtool original.
